raw.details:
Event Details

  • Date: 24 October 2026
  • Time: 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM
  • Venue: Room 339/340, I.T.S. Engineering College, Greater Noida
  • Registration Fee: ₹300 per team
  • Prize Pool: ₹22,000
  • Team Size: 2 participants per team

Event Description

The Business Plan Competition gives participants a platform to present innovative ideas, explore real-world problem-solving, and understand how an idea can be transformed into a viable market opportunity. Teams pitch their business concept before a jury, demonstrating their grasp of the problem, proposed solution, target market, business model, financial viability, scalability, and future growth — while also getting a chance to discuss their ideas, seek clarity on commercialization, and gain insight into positioning innovations in the market.

Guidelines

Team Size

  • 2 participants per team

Pitch Structure

Teams should cover the following areas in their pitch:

  • Problem & Opportunity
  • Solution & Value Proposition
  • Target Customers
  • Market & Competition
  • Business & Revenue Model
  • Go-to-Market Plan
  • Financial Requirements & Projections
  • Team & Execution Plan
  • Future Roadmap

Pitch Format

  • 5 minutes: Presentation
  • 3 minutes: Jury Q&A
  • The time limit will be strictly enforced; teams may be stopped once presentation time ends

Important

  • Financial projections should be reasonable and supported by clear assumptions
  • Teams should be prepared to defend their assumptions regarding pricing, market size, customer acquisition, and revenue

Judging Criteria

Criteria Weightage
Problem & Solution 15%
Innovation 15%
Market Opportunity 15%
Business Model 15%
Revenue & Financial Viability 15%
Scalability 10%
Pitch Quality 10%
Q&A 5%
Total 100%

Disqualification

As per the common TechTrix'26 rules applicable to all events, the following will result in immediate disqualification:

  • Misconduct with judges, volunteers, or organisers
  • Physical altercation or deliberate damage to venue/property
  • Cheating or plagiarism (e.g., presenting an idea that is not the team's own without disclosure)
  • Use of another team's material or misrepresentation of participant identity
  • Receiving unauthorized external assistance during the competition

The Event Jury/Organizing Committee holds final authority on judging, penalties, disqualification, and interpretation of rules.

Opportunities for Winners:

Incubation Support — Up to ₹90,000
Get incubation support worth up to ₹90,000 for 18 months to develop and scale your innovative idea.

Expert Mentorship
Receive guidance from industry experts and experienced mentors to refine your idea, strategy, and business model.

Product Development Support
Get hands-on support to build, test, and refine your product and turn your idea into a market-ready solution.

NOTE-: Registration Fees are not refundable.
